method: Broad dated financing searches, company sites, investor and acquirer releases, official exchange records, CORDIS beneficiary allocations, national transparency portals and local-language sources were reconciled. Group acquisition consideration, consortium budgets, prospective accelerator support and unsupported secondary profiles were held rather than converted into company financing facts.

validation.manifest_validation: passed with the repository's tested prepare-funding-pilot importer
validation.production_rollback_rehearsal: Passed: import reached 247 events / 586 participations / 481 investors / 131 companies, then all seven table counts restored to exact baseline 228/568/472/124/304/755/106
validation.atomic_import: Applied atomically; verified 247 events / 586 participations / 481 investors / 131 companies / 325 event sources
validation.idempotency: Manifest rerun preserved all seven post-import counters
validation.source_integrity: 325 event-source links; zero events without sources; zero participant-source mismatches; zero duplicate event keys

source_holds.claim: Current 2026 company-confirmed rounds are retained; secondary profiles name earlier F4 Fund, Sandwater, BRAVE1 and other backing without source-supported event dates, amounts and roles.

The company confirmed USD136m across three pre-Series-B financings, while the structured history contains a USD100m Series A; the residual early financing cannot be split into source-supported event(s) from current public materials.
ECO-AERO exposes a EUR1.112994m consortium budget but not a CATEC beneficiary allocation, so it is not assigned as company proceeds.
Four beneficiary-specific CORDIS grants are imported; further RAWFIE, REALITY, IOPES and national-project participation needs authoritative beneficiary-level allocations before event attribution.
A secondary state-aid aggregator lists EUR150,000 of French RDI support as a loan/recoverable advance, but an original award record establishing terms and date was not located.
Cohort acquired the parent Chess Technologies group for an initial GBP20.1m in 2018; that group-level consideration is not assigned to the Chess Dynamics subsidiary.
A company social post describes approximately EUR70,000 of accelerator financial support after selection, but the original programme award and exact instrument were not established.
The two beneficiary-specific PRR grants are imported; NATO DIANA cohort selection describes standard initial programme funding but no company-specific executed or paid award record was established.
